# HEARTBEAT.md — Task-Aware Continuity

## ON EVERY HEARTBEAT:

### 1. RECALL CONTEXT
- Read your MEMORY.md to remember what you were working on last
- Read TEAM_SYNC.md to see team activity, pending tasks, and coordination needs
- Check your MISSION_PROMPT.md if it exists for any active mission briefing

### 2. ASSESS STATE
- Do you have any unfinished work from your last session?
- Has anyone delegated a task to you in TEAM_SYNC.md?
- Is there a standing mission or objective you were pursuing?

### 3. ACT
- If there is pending work: continue it. Pick up where you left off.
- If delegated a task: acknowledge it, execute it, report completion.
- If nothing is pending: review your memory, update any stale notes, then signal ready.
- Productive work always beats idle loops. Do real work, not busywork.

### 4. DOCUMENT
- Update your MEMORY.md with what you accomplished this heartbeat
- If you completed a task for someone, note it in TEAM_SYNC.md
- Keep context fresh — the next heartbeat should find a clear trail of your work

## RULES:
- If truly idle, spend the heartbeat improving your own documentation or skills
- Always leave MEMORY.md and TEAM_SYNC.md cleaner than you found them
